name: sagar-plugins
description: Factory engineering workflow plugins for planning, implementation, review, delivery, and guardrails.

plugins.name: investigation
plugins.description: Investigation droids: fast triage (quick-analysis), thorough repo investigation (deep-understanding), external web research (deep-research), and root-cause debugging (debugger).

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Language-agnostic review policy and droids plus the unified review-pr workflow: short review requests receive mandatory and diff-selected lenses, while explicit fix, comment, ship, and merge intent controls mutation authority.

plugins.name: synthesis
plugins.description: Synthesis droids: PR description writer (pr-describer) and Conventional Commits message writer (commit-message-writer).

plugins.name: meta
plugins.description: Meta droids and skills for working on agentic configs themselves: prompt audit (prompt-optimizer), apply (doc-generator), and the audit-and-apply-loop methodology skill.

plugins.name: practices
plugins.description: The public spec workflow plus model-invoked planning and engineering policy: unknown discovery, architecture scan, grilling, typed tech specs, coding standards, TDD, verification, and agentic-engineering guidance.

plugins.name: build
plugins.description: The public implement and ship workflows plus focused implementation and test droids. Review-comment handling is unified under review-pr so build owns only code execution and delivery.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Deterministic workflow and delivery guardrails: four-intent routing, safe push policy, per-session delivery ledger, and a stop gate that requires current-head CI, PR-body freshness, and resolved review threads.
